reviews.title: Great price for this motherboard!
reviews.comment: Cheaper than normal, came exactly as said, nothing damaged, and I really recommend this motherboard and it came in great packaging! But didn't come with the io shield ): but that's ok.

reviews.title: Good value at $80
reviews.comment: Works as intended with updated firmware for mobo.  Did not come with WiFi antenna or shield but purchased refurbished so expected something like that.
reviews.author: A. Moomaw

reviews.title: Good cheap motherboard
reviews.comment: I"m not an Asus fan at all, but the price was right on these boards and they do all I need them to do. I bought one brand-new one that is in my main computer. I went to the Asus web site to see which RAM is compatible and the RAM I bought that was on their list didn't work. I bought some other RAM that wasn't on their list and it did work. Other than that, it's been fine and running good for two years now. I have since bought two more of these motherboards used-like new to go into other computers and they've been running fine as well.
reviews.author: Kevinp
